title: TSAE-UAV: A time-sense autoencoder for unsupervised anomaly detection of UAV based on flight data
protocol_adaptations: Use the fixed ALFA 29/1/16 split and the current 12-channel common-data export.
Use stride 16 for both training and scoring.
Replace the paper's percentile/point-adjusted decision rule with causal EMA plus flightwise SPOT.
Report Micro label_any metrics under the shared revision protocol.
